eDevice
is a global IoT connectivity and remote patient monitoring (RPM) solution provider owned by
iHealth Labs / Andon Health
. It specializes in medical-grade cellular gateways, modules, and data transmission services rather than consumer-facing retail brands.
eDevice
Product Brands & Flagship Solutions
HealthGO:
A medical hub and plug-and-play remote patient monitoring gateway designed to collect and securely transmit clinical data from various home peripherals (like scales or blood pressure monitors).
eDevice
TwoCan Pulse:
A certified telecardiology and chronic heart condition management system.
eDevice
eDevice Modules/Modems:
Embedded custom data-transfer hardware integrated inside third-party medical hardware for global cellular and PSTN migration support.
